Name: SQL-03 MBIClaims Clean
QueryText:
SELECT
    src.Policy_Number                       AS POLICYNO,
    src.Product_Group                       AS RISKTYPE,
    src.Make                                AS MAKE,
    src.Model                               AS MODEL,
    src.Year_Of_Manu                        AS YEAR,
    src.Insured_First_Name                  AS FNAME,
    src.Insured_Last_Name                   AS LNAME,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))    AS EMAIL,
    src.Claim_Number                        AS CLAIMNO,
    src.First_Settled_Date                  AS SETTLED,
    'Standard'                              AS CLAIM

FROM DE_Raw_Claims src

/* ── RULE 5: Deduplication ───────────────────────────────────
   P050481286 had 3 claims all settled on same day but different
   timestamps (10:33:41, 10:33:47, 10:33:53). The earliest
   timestamp (C050093238) is kept. MIN(First_Settled_Date)
   handles this correctly including the time component.        */
/* When multiple claims settle on the exact same date,
   fall back to MIN(Claim_Number) as a stable tiebreaker */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        Policy_Number,
        MIN(Claim_Number) AS KeepClaim
    FROM DE_Raw_Claims
    WHERE Product_Group = 'MBI'
      AND Claim_Client_Email IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email)) <> ''
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'noemail@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tba@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbc@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbd@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE '%@noemail%'
      AND Claim_Number NOT IN (
          SELECT Claim_Number FROM DE_ExcludedClaims
      )
    GROUP BY Policy_Number
) dedup
    ON  src.Policy_Number = dedup.Policy_Number
    AND src.Claim_Number  = dedup.KeepClaim

WHERE
    /* ── RULE 1: MBI only ──────────────────────────────────── */
    src.Product_Group = 'MBI'

    /* ── RULE 2: Email must exist ──────────────────────────── */
AND src.Claim_Client_Email IS NOT NULL
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email)) <> ''

    /* ── RULE 3: Fake email suppression ───────────────────── */
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'noemail@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tba@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbc@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbd@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE '%@noemail%'

    /* ── RULE 4: Excluded claims suppression ──────────────── */
AND src.Claim_Number NOT IN (
    SELECT Claim_Number FROM DE_ExcludedClaims
)

Name: SQL-01 CustomerServices Clean
QueryText:
/* ============================================================
   SQL-01: Customer Services CSAT — Clean & Transform
   Source : DE_Raw_CustomerServices   (36 rows raw)
   Target : DE_CustomerServices_Clean (33 rows expected)
   
   Rules applied:
   1. Insured_Contact_Current_Flag = 'Y'  (all rows in test file are Y)
   2. Email not blank / null
   3. Fake email suppression  (removes P050538110 — noemail@noemail.com)
   4. Car dealer email suppression
   5. Dedup: one row per Policy_Number
              P050538211 → keep REGO XP2472  (MIN alphabetically)
              P050538212 → keep Policy Type 'MTA of New Policy' (MIN alphabetically)
   6. STAFF = first word of Customer_Service_Name
   ============================================================ */

SELECT
    d.Policy_Number                                     AS POLICYNO,
    d.Policy_Type                                       AS POLICYTYPE,
    d.Cover_Description                                 AS COVER,
    d.Agent_Name                                        AS DEALER,
    d.Policy_Inception_TPI_Date                         AS INCEPTION,
    d.Insured_First_Name                                AS FNAME,
    d.Insured_Last_Name                                 AS LNAME,
    d.Rego_No                                           AS REGO,
    d.Make                                              AS MAKE,
    d.Model                                             AS MODEL,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))              AS EMAIL,

    /* STAFF: extract first name only from "Firstname Lastname" */
    CASE
        WHEN CHARINDEX(' ', LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Customer_Service_Name))) > 0
        THEN LEFT(
                LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Customer_Service_Name)),
                CHARINDEX(' ', LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Customer_Service_Name))) - 1
             )
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Customer_Service_Name))
    END                                                 AS STAFF

FROM DE_Raw_CustomerServices d

/* ── DEDUPLICATION ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   For P050538211: two different REGOs (XP2472, ZR2745) — keep XP2472
   For P050538212: two different Policy Types (MTA, New Business) — keep MTA
   Strategy: for each Policy_Number, keep the row where
   (Policy_Type, Rego_No) = the MIN combination */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        Policy_Number,
        MIN(Policy_Type) AS KeepPolicyType,
        MIN(Rego_No)     AS KeepRego
    FROM DE_Raw_CustomerServices
    WHERE Insured_Contact_Current_Flag = 'Y'
      AND Insured_Contact_Number IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(Insured_Contact_Number)) <> ''
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'noemail@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'tba@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'tbc@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'tbd@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%@noemail%'
    GROUP BY Policy_Number
) dedup
    ON  d.Policy_Number  = dedup.Policy_Number
    AND d.Policy_Type    = dedup.KeepPolicyType
    AND d.Rego_No        = dedup.KeepRego

WHERE
    /* Rule 1 — Active contact record only */
    d.Insured_Contact_Current_Flag = 'Y'

    /* Rule 2 — Email must exist */
AND d.Insured_Contact_Number IS NOT NULL
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number)) <> ''

    /* Rule 3 — Fake email suppression */
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'noemail@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'tba@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'tbc@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE 'tbd@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%@noemail%'

    /* Rule 4 — Car dealer email suppression */
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%motor%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%vehicle%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%automotive%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%carcentre%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%caryard%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%carsales%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(d.Insured_Contact_Number))) NOT LIKE '%valuemotors%'

Name: SQL-02 MotorClaims Clean
QueryText:
SELECT
    src.Policy_Number                       AS POLICYNO,
    src.Product_Group                       AS RISKTYPE,
    src.Make                                AS MAKE,
    src.Model                               AS MODEL,
    src.Year_Of_Manu                        AS YEAR,
    src.Insured_First_Name                  AS FNAME,
    src.Insured_Last_Name                   AS LNAME,
    LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))    AS EMAIL,
    src.Claim_Number                        AS CLAIMNO,
    src.First_Settled_Date                  AS SETTLED,

    /* ── RULE 7: Windscreen routing ──────────────────────────
       MV07 WINDSCREEN = standard MVI windscreen claim
       PC07 WINDSCREEN = PCC (personal contract cover) windscreen
       Both route to 'Windscreen & keys' journey             */
    CASE
        WHEN src.Claim_Primary_Cause_Description LIKE '%WINDSCREEN%'
        THEN 'Windscreen & keys'
        ELSE 'Standard'
    END                                     AS CLAIM

FROM DE_Raw_Claims src

/* ── RULE 6: Deduplication ───────────────────────────────────
   When a policy has multiple claims (e.g. P050267252 had 2
   windscreen claims in the same week), keep only the earliest
   settled claim to avoid double-emailing the same customer.
   MIN(First_Settled_Date) per Policy_Number = earliest claim. */
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT
        Policy_Number,
        MIN(First_Settled_Date) AS EarliestSettled
    FROM DE_Raw_Claims
    WHERE Product_Group IN ('MVI','MCI','PCC')
      AND Product_Group NOT IN ('GAP','CPI','FPP','MPP','PPI','LPI')
      AND Claim_Client_Email IS NOT NULL
      AND LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email)) <> ''
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'noemail@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tba@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbc@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbd@%'
      AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE '%@noemail%'
      AND Claim_Number NOT IN (
          SELECT Claim_Number FROM DE_ExcludedClaims
      )
    GROUP BY Policy_Number
) dedup
    ON  src.Policy_Number       = dedup.Policy_Number
    AND src.First_Settled_Date  = dedup.EarliestSettled

WHERE
    /* ── RULE 1: Motor product groups only ─────────────────── */
    src.Product_Group IN ('MVI','MCI','PCC')

    /* ── RULE 2: Finance claims excluded ───────────────────── */
AND src.Product_Group NOT IN ('GAP','CPI','FPP','MPP','PPI','LPI')

    /* ── RULE 3: Email must exist ──────────────────────────── */
AND src.Claim_Client_Email IS NOT NULL
AND LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email)) <> ''

    /* ── RULE 4: Fake email suppression ───────────────────── */
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'noemail@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tba@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbc@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE 'tbd@%'
AND LOWER(LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Claim_Client_Email))) NOT LIKE '%@noemail%'

    /* ── RULE 5: Excluded claims suppression ──────────────── */
AND src.Claim_Number NOT IN (
    SELECT Claim_Number FROM DE_ExcludedClaims
)

Name: SQL-04 Dealer Clean
QueryText:
SELECT

    src.Policy_Type                                 AS POLICYTYPE,
    src.Cover_Description                           AS COVER,
    src.Agent_Name                                  AS DEALER,


    src.Policy_Inception_TPI_Date                   AS INCEPTION,
    src.Sale_Calendar_Date                          AS EXPIRY,

    CASE
        WHEN LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Insured_First_Name)) = 'X'
        THEN 'Assurant customer'
        ELSE LTRIM(RTRIM(src.Insured_First_Name))
    END                                             AS FNAME,

    src.Insured_Last_Name                           AS LNAME,
    src.Rego_No                                     AS REGO,
    src.Make                                        AS MAKE,
    src.Model                                       AS MODEL,

INNER JOIN (

Name: GeicoAutoCancel-01-SQL-KPI
Description: This query is designed to find KPI like-Sent, Open, Click, Bounce, Unsub)
QueryText:
SELECT
    g.EmailAddress,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Min(s.EventDate), 23) AS EmailSentDate,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MAX(o.EventDate), 23) AS EmailOpenDate,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MAX(b.EventDate), 23) AS EmailBounceDate,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MAX(c.EventDate), 23) AS EmailClickDate,
    CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), MAX(u.EventDate), 23) AS EmailUnsubscribeDate,
    g.PolicyNumber,
    s.SubscriberKey,
  
    MAX(s.JobID) AS JobID,
    j.EmailName
FROM Geico_Auto_Cxl_Comm g

INNER JOIN _Sent s
    ON g.EmailAddress = s.SubscriberKey
    AND (
        g.DateAdded IS NULL 
        OR CAST(g.DateAdded AS DATE) = CAST(s.EventDate AS DATE)
    )
    
INNER JOIN _Job j
    ON s.JobID = j.JobID
    AND j.EmailName = 'Assurant and GEICO auto cross-sell'

LEFT JOIN _Open o
    ON s.SubscriberKey = o.SubscriberKey
  AND o.JobID = s.JobID
      AND o.ListID = s.ListID
      AND o.BatchID = s.BatchID
      AND o.SubscriberID = s.SubscriberID
      AND o.EventDate >= s.EventDate

LEFT JOIN _Bounce b
    ON s.SubscriberKey = b.SubscriberKey
    AND s.JobID = b.JobID

LEFT JOIN _Click c
    ON s.SubscriberKey = c.SubscriberKey
    AND s.JobID = c.JobID

LEFT JOIN _Unsubscribe u
    ON s.SubscriberKey = u.SubscriberKey
    AND s.JobID = u.JobID

GROUP BY
    g.EmailAddress,
    g.PolicyNumber,
    s.SubscriberKey,
    j.EmailName

        g.DateAdded IS NULL

    )
    
INNER JOIN _Job j

    AND j.EmailName = 'Assurant and GEICO auto cross-sell'

LEFT JOIN _Open o
    ON s.SubscriberKey = o.SubscriberKey
  AND o.JobID = s.JobID
      AND o.ListID = s.ListID
      AND o.BatchID = s.BatchID
      AND o.SubscriberID = s.SubscriberID
      AND o.EventDate >= s.EventDate

LEFT JOIN _Bounce b
    ON s.SubscriberKey = b.SubscriberKey
    AND s.JobID = b.JobID

LEFT JOIN _Click c
    ON s.SubscriberKey = c.SubscriberKey
    AND s.JobID = c.JobID

LEFT JOIN _Unsubscribe u
    ON s.SubscriberKey = u.SubscriberKey
    AND s.JobID = u.JobID

GROUP BY
    g.EmailAddress,
    g.PolicyNumber,
    s.SubscriberKey,
    j.EmailName
